blocks.text: Following John Macias's note, I wanted to close the loop on the draft itself. The revised first set of core messages for {{fact:f:E-2023-001.client}} is ready on our side, and I will send it in a form you can mark up directly, with the two or three lines that turn on the audience question flagged so they are easy to find.

So the interviews and the draft do not cross, I have held the executive language loosely where I expect their own words to change it. If you can point me to the people John will be sitting with, I will make sure the questions we bring line up with the messages the Suarez-Jones executives will end up carrying.

I will get the marked draft to you this week either way. If reading it cold is awkward, a short call works just as well, and I will set one up around your schedule. For our file, final sign-off on the wording stays with you, Jennifer Herrera.
